notes.content:
[list]
[*] To help new players avoid common early mistakes, 'Auto Upgrade' is now enabled by default in the settings menu.
[/list]

notes.content: Slightly improved the EXTREMELY INTELLIGENT AI™ in the 'Auto Upgrade' setting, which allows the game AI to select upgrades for you.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.3
notes.content:
[b]New Feature: Auto Upgrade[/b]
When you enable "Auto upgrade" in the settings, the game will run uninterrupted and our EXTREMELY INTELLIGENT AI™ will automatically provide you with the best upgrades.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.1
notes.content:
[b]New Feature: Leaderboard country flags.[/b]

This update allows you to see the country flag of the players that are on the leaderboards!

If you have already played the game, you need to beat your current high score as it is not submitted in earlier releases.
